title: Split the inventory type
summary: Break an inventory class that does everything into small types and functions with one responsibility each.
instructions: run_inventory(operations) executes the operations in order and returns one output per operation.
['add', sku, qty] adds stock and outputs null. ['remove', sku, qty] removes stock and outputs true, or outputs false and changes nothing when there is not enough.
['count', sku] outputs the current quantity (0 for an unknown sku). ['low', threshold] outputs the sorted skus whose quantity is below threshold.
The starter class is correct but mixes storage, rules, reporting and command handling.
Keep at least one class, and keep every class small.
constraints: Every class is at most 25 lines long.
Every class has at most 5 methods.

acceptance_criteria.description: The examples produce the expected outputs.
All further operation sequences produce the expected outputs.
The solution defines at least one class.
Every class is at most 25 lines long and has at most 5 methods.
